• Working on Reinforcement Learning to enhance the reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs).
  • Implemented novel reward modeling using a hybrid reward mechanism with support for both sparse and dense rewards for VLMs.
  • Worked on enabling and performance tuning of inference engines to accelerate data synthesis efforts.

• Accelerated inference by 5× on single-node DL and by 2× on multi-node distributed DL for high-resolution images using quantization.
  • Implemented MPI4DL, Distributed Deep Learning models to train large models with high-resolution images
  • Enabled training of out-of-core ResNet and AmoebaNet models for 8K and 16K image sizes

• Designed and developed state-of-the-art persistent B+ tree to optimize the object storage engine used by CORTX (an open-source, cloud-distributed storage) codebase
  • Assisted memory limit feature to reduce primary memory consumption from 95% to acceptable levels in absence of swap space
  • Implemented various node formats for variable-sized objects with CRC (Cyclic redundancy check) support for data recovery
  • Achieved performance improvement of up to 30% read and 10% write object in case of direct addressing (i.e., the object will reside in node) and 60% read object for indirect addressing (i.e., the node will hold the address of object)
• Led proof-of-concept to provide optimal object storage over in-used B tree, which involved research on B+ tree and B-epsilon object storage techniques
